verdict.rationale: Omarchy's source appears to be publicly readable: a first-party GitHub repository (basecamp/omarchy) is cited, a community user describes reading the repo to reuse parts of the setup, and another references a specific commit (9285b19). However, no evidence in the pack names the license or states that the code is open source, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement (e.g., MIT/GPL) in docs or repo, first-party documentation on accessing and reusing the source.
